authorization: User approved full native extraction and bounded training experiment after reviewing temporal repair preparation results.
admission: New recipe version; only pinned positive events from the reviewed contract plus exact prior-admitted isolated replay caches. Not a canonical training flag change or historical mixed trainer bypass.
exclusions: unlabeled gaps and uncertain boundary labels

training.sampling: Equal class mass within each source; equal source-domain isolated mass; temporal equal class then equal event then equal eligible view. Source roles preserved.
training.loss: CE(all samples) + KL(incumbent teacher on isolated replay, temperature=2, multiplied by T^2) + .01 * sum(mean squared head parameter deviation)
training.frozen: Both complete encoders in eval mode, byte-identical weights; precompute full temporal encoder outputs once, with direct-model parity checks.

selection.retention: Every represented class in each Citizen/SemLex/local validation domain must retain >= incumbent correct count; all100Citizen classes required. No aggregate regression.
selection.objective: Among eligible checkpoints: maximize number of validation source events correct on all eligible views, then minimize equal-event mean cross entropy; retain earlier on exact tie.
selection.secondary: Save one best temporal diagnostic candidate ignoring retention, clearly ineligible if it fails; never promote it.
selection.phone: Post-selection diagnosis only. Never select hyperparameters/checkpoints using the known phone failures.

evaluation.all_classes: isolated domain per-class counts and native570cached streaming cases
evaluation.development: native MY/HAVE/September30 phase sweeps plus genuine LIKE controls; separate incumbent-runtime and contact/continuous-runtime arms
evaluation.promotion: Fresh independent normal-phone evaluation required after all development gates; no automatic install from this experiment

remaining_admission_checks: core hand/crop eligibility with exclusions recorded
no parent/signer split overlap within source
full training and feature-cache hash pins
executable trainer hash and negative gate tests
isolated_overlap_policy: Reconcile stale SemLex replay cache to finalized source membership: keep1388 approved train rows, exclude25 unapproved duplicate validation rows, retain953 validation rows. Preserve old caches and original roles.
timestamp_policy: Reviewed frame indices resolved from integer PTS/time_base; decimal-rounded preparation eligibility counts superseded. Exclude variants with fewer than two actual core-hand frames.
export_policy: Keep incumbent letter-head weights and its original fused-word-score input branch frozen. Adapted word output is separate; verify exact PyTorch letter equality and padded all378 FP16 parity. No letter retraining or altered word-mode gate.
